data.description:
## Surface
AWS CloudWatch, region us-east-1, account 896586841071, host `rebar-gerrit` (rebar-autodeploy.service).

## Signature (three correlated `rebar/host` autodeploy alarms flapped in-window)
1. **rebar-autodeploy-errors** — `deploy_errors` (AUTODEPLOY_ERROR markers): **11** OK→ALARM transitions in window; currently OK (recovered 2026-08-30T17:32 PDT). Deploy is fail-safe (last-known-good stays live) but a sustained signal = `main` not reaching the box.
2. **rebar-autodeploy-mcp-retire-cap** — `mcp_retire_cap`: **11** OK→ALARM transitions; currently OK (recovered 2026-08-30T03:12 PDT). Blue/green port-pool cap hit — retiring mcp containers not draining, new releases back off.
3. **rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-signal-unavailable** — `review_interrupts_signal_unavailable`: **2** OK→ALARM (2026-08-30T16:53 PDT, cleared 17:08). This is the URGENT one: the review-bot `/health` `in_flight` drain check could not be read, so a deploy recreated the review-bot with NO drain check (the exact silent regression bug 34cd exists to catch).

## First/last seen in-window
autodeploy-errors + mcp-retire-cap: recurring across 2026-08-29T21:52 PDT → 2026-08-30T16:58 PDT. signal-unavailable: 2026-08-30T16:53 PDT.

## Dedup
- deploy_errors prior root cause **6af7-edb7-88ce-4110** (P1, "mcp autodeploy crash-loops on AuthConfigError … rebar-autodeploy-errors in ALARM") is **closed** → links `duplicates`. Cadence bug **ac14** is also closed.
- mcp-retire-cap relates to closed **40a7** (uvicorn graceful-shutdown coupled to 1200s drain) and closed story **6964**.
- signal-unavailable relates to closed **34cd / 7b4a**; **check e2a6 first** — it documented cold-start journal-republish producing FALSE firings of this exact counter.

## Severity: P2
Deploy path is fail-safe (no outage), but heavy sustained flapping across two autodeploy targets plus the paging drain-check signal means releases are not landing cleanly and in-flight reviews may have been killed blind. All prior root-cause tickets are closed = regression.

## Provenance
Periodic ops-error sweep (window 2026-08-29T10:00 → 2026-08-30T17:36 PDT). Triage only — not root-caused; assignee should split targets if root causes diverge.
